rationale: The portable offline ZIP must work for a standard user without an administrator-installed Visual C++ runtime. Microsoft prefers centrally serviced dynamic CRTs for installer deployments; this portable product deliberately accepts responsibility for rebuilding and redistributing the entire app after toolset/CRT security updates. No DLL is copied from a developer machine or downloaded at runtime.
validation_limits: PE normal and delay-import gates prove the declared direct native dependency closure, not successful startup, WebView2 availability, runtime LoadLibrary behavior, organizational execution policy or clean-VM acceptance.
